description: Fuel consumption - road - GFEI is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Global Fuel Economy Initiative. Fuel consumption - passenger cars by vehicle type, by powertrain technology. Coverage: Egypt. The portal files it under the publisher Global Fuel Economy Initiative. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, XML. The portal shows 2024-11-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
